Method of Attack: Inject malicious DEX files inside a valid Android app update (APK file) by exploiting a vulnerability in Android OS signature verification mechanism
Bypass app signatures and inject malicious code into Android apps
DEX insertion does not alter bytes Android checks for integrity, so file signature remains unchanged
Impacted Systems: Android devices running Android 5.0 and later
Attack Vector: Malicious DEX injection inside APK files distributed via third-party app stores
Malicious updates disguised as legitimate app updates
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious DEX files inside APK updates
Apps signed with app signature scheme v1 (not v2)
